title: Isaiah's Call
description: In the year that King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord seated on a high and lofty throne in the temple, surrounded by seraphim crying out, "Holy, holy, holy." A seraph purified his lips with a burning coal from the altar, and Isaiah answered the Lord's call: "Here I am; send me!"

versions.title: Isaiah's Call
versions.description: Isaiah saw God in the temple, surrounded by seraphim. His lips were cleansed with a burning coal, and he responded: 'Here I am; send me!'
